x_ramza_comment: ECL v2.0 RAMZA TRANCE specification envelope.
objective: Propose account-isolated bidirectional Google Calendar synchronization with multi-account aliases, calendar discovery, routed Jin events, and unified agenda management.

context_delta.summary: Full-tier TRANCE specification with 11 dependency-ordered stories and 54 frozen EARS checks, amended after FORGE deliberation. It binds Jin account IDs to stable Google subjects, makes singleton migration fail-closed and idempotent, enforces account-scoped credentials and refresh locks, keys provider recurrence state compositionally, quarantines revoked work for explicit review, preserves exact intent-time routes, and executes behind hard A-to-B-to-C-to-D barriers.

assumptions: Owner-provisioned OAuth client credentials are shared while account authorization tokens remain isolated.
Provider accessRole is refreshed before paused writes resume.
Live Google validation is a separately labeled non-hermetic release attestation.
